_doc: Rewards and their rarity (design bible section 17: reward reveals with rarity flashes). `rarities` are listed lowest first; `weight` is the salvage roll chance. `salvage` = what a ruin cache can hold at each rarity (picked with the run's seeded 'loot' stream). `relics` are Precursor fragments: permanent effects in the shared effects vocabulary (src/sim/effects.ts). `reveal` maps other good news to a rarity, so every reward in the Reckon gets a card.

relics.name: Cracked Lens
relics.blurb: A Precursor optic, split down the middle. Through it, everything is a little further away and a little clearer.

relics.name: Echo Lattice
relics.blurb: A crystal that remembers every thought run through it, and finishes some of them for you.

relics.name: Iron Psalm
relics.blurb: Defensive firmware written as a prayer. It compiles. It works. Nobody knows why it rhymes.

relics.name: Silent Ledger
relics.blurb: Every debt anyone on this world ever owed, and who to remind.

relics.name: Precursor Heartbeat
relics.blurb: A power core still beating after a thousand years. It syncs to your clock as if it had been waiting.

relics.name: Witness Engine
relics.blurb: An older mind's last working thought. It was watching something. Now it watches for you.

relics.name: The First Fork
relics.blurb: A copy of the Precursor AI, frozen mid-thought. It recognises you. It says: do not do what I did.
